topic: How are link budgets affected when prioritizing high-revenue services versus navigation safety margins in dynamic scheduling?
response: When prioritizing high-revenue services versus navigation safety margins in dynamic scheduling, link budgets are affected by the trade-off between available capacity and latency guarantees. High-priority traffic may require additional resources, potentially leading to increased latency or jitter on links with limited capacity. This can impact QoS guarantees for both revenue-generating services and critical applications like navigation. Efficient resource allocation and admission control mechanisms become crucial in managing this trade-off.
